content.en_US:
Used to process flight data created by [[space labs|Space Laboratory]], as well as simulate particle data for crafting the [[fusion reactor vessel|Fusion Reactor Vessel]], and flight simulation data for the [[Soyuz]]. Cannot be sped up by upgrades, rather it features alternate recipes with different cooling options which accelerate the recipe, at the cost of lowering the success chance.

Can also create Klaus, although we still don't know why anyone would want that.
